## 🚀 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of what the feature is and what problem it solves.

## 💡 Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented, including potential API endpoints, agent workflows, or UI views.

## 🎯 Target Use Case & User Persona
- **Who uses this?** (e.g. Sales Reps, Customer Success Managers, Revenue Operations, System Admins)
- **Why is this valuable?**

## 🎨 UI/UX Mockups & Specifications (if applicable)
Add any diagrams, sketches, or wireframes.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.
